## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Build succeeds.
- [ ] Lint passes, including dependency boundaries.
- [ ] Strict typecheck passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Formatting passes.
- [ ] Shared contracts remain compatible, or all owners reviewed the migration.
- [ ] No secrets added.
- [ ] Impact on other modules checked.
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed.
